cursor.frontmatter:
name: research
description: >-
  Compares two or more approaches without editing code. Use when the user
  asks 哪个好 / 选哪个 / 两种做法 / 利弊 / 方案对比, or names research. Not
  for a single factual answer or a yes/no question. Default reply is the
  summary layer; full 做法/收益/代价/风险 fields only when the user asks to
  expand the whole comparison.
disable-model-invocation: true
